creature_text.Text: <cough> Spare me your paltry words, Sliver. I've not taken my final breath yet!

These cursed demons are going to learn a new meaning of suffering when I get free! A beast called Zalinor carries the keystone that unlocks these bindings. Set me free and I'll help you rip the bastards apart!
We don't have much time! Margrave was taken to the citadel. The only things I've seen come out of that place are demons and corpses! We'll need to break in there to get him out.
What!? Don't you have any sense of duty to aid your fellow knights?
You're a cold one, Sliver. Fine! I'll help, but if we have any chance of getting Margrave out alive, we should take it.
Легион забрал мое оружие, так что будет честно, если я возьму оружие у демонов.

creature_text.Text: Poor Margrave! The final death claimed you at last.
